description:
## Al-Mursalat - The Sent Forth

(Revealed at Mecca)

50 Verses in 2 Sections

## Sections Of Surah Al-Mursalat

1. The Day of Requital.
2. The Reward and the Punishment.

## Important Topics

1. The happenings on the Day of Judgment (Verses 8-10)
2. The fate of the disbelievers and the wicked (Verses 15-40)
3. The recompense to the righteous (Verses 41-45)

## Al-Mursalat Section 1 - The Day Of Requital

Woe on the day unto the beliers, The lot of the guilty

In the name of God the Beneficent the Merciful

## Al-Mursalat Section 2 - The Reward And The Punishment

The reward the righteous will get and the punishment to be meted out to the guilty, on the Day of Judgment

translations.1: By those sent forth with goodness, one after another
translations.2: Which then rage (Exciting, excitement.) in violent rage
translations.3: And by those which spread (goodness) far and wide
translations.4: Then by those that separate (As the result of the Spreading.) them from one another
translations.5: Then by those that give forth the Reminder
translations.6: Either justify (the punishment), or to warn
translations.7: Verily, what hath been promised (The Day of Judgement.) unto you shall come to pass (Refer to Verses <{["Q", "51:1"]}> - <{["Q", "51:6"]}>.)
translations.8: So, when the stars shall be caused to cease radiating (As the consequence of the cessation of the radiation. Refer to Verses <{["Q", "81:2"]}>, <{["Q", "82:2"]}>.)
translations.9: And when the heaven shall be rent asunder (Refer to Verses <{["Q", "82:1"]}>, <{["Q", "73:18"]}>.)
translations.10: And when the mountains shall be carried away like the dust (Refer to Verses <{["Q", "69:14"]}>, <{["Q", "81:3"]}>.)
translations.11: And when the messengers are made to reach their appointed time (Signs of the dawn of the Day of Final Judgment.)
translations.12: To what day is the appointment (fixed)?
translations.13: To the day of decision (When the truth and the falsehood will be sorted out. Refer to Verses <{["Q", "37:21"]}>, <{["Q", "44:40"]}>.) !
translations.14: And what will make thee know what the Day of Decision is?
translations.15: Woe on the Day unto the beliers
translations.16: What! Destroyed We not the former people?
translations.17: Then did We make the later people follow them
translations.18: Thus, We deal with the guilty ones
translations.19: Woe on the Day unto the beliers
translations.20: Did We not create you from a fluid despicable (Refer to Verses <{["Q", "32:8"]}>, <{["Q", "23:13"]}>.) ?
translations.21: Then We placed it in a safe place (Mother's womb. Refer to Verse <{["Q", "23:13"]}> .)
translations.23: So We planned then how Excellent are (We) the planners
translations.24: Woe on the Day unto the beliers!
translations.25: Have We not made the earth a receptacle?
translations.26: For the living and (also for) the dead ones
translations.27: And made We therein mountains high (Refer to Verses <{["Q", "16:15"]}>, <{["Q", "13:3"]}>.) , and given you to drink water sweet?
translations.28: 'Woe on the Day unto the beliers!
translations.29: Begone ye unto that which ye belied (Hell, which the disbelievers belied.) !
translations.30: Begone ye unto the shadow having three columns (Hell with smoke rising in columns)
translations.31: (Which yieldeth) no shade (for coolness) nor availing against the flames
translations.32: Verily, it sendeth up sparks like a palace
translations.33: As if they are tawny camels
translations.34: Woe on the Day unto the beliers!
translations.35: This is the day when they shall speak not
translations.36: And it shall not be permitted unto them so that they may offer excuses (Refers to a particular stage of the day of requital.)
translations.37: Woe on the Day unto the beliers
translations.38: This is the Day of decision; We will gather you and (all) those of yore
translations.39: If ye have any device, try ye that device (now)!
translations.40: Woe on the Day unto the beliers!
translations.41: Verily the pious ones (Those who guard against evil. Refer to Verses <{["Q", "56:89"]}>; <{["Q", "56:10"]}> - <{["Q", "56:38"]}>.) shall be amid shades and springs
translations.42: And fruits (Refer to Verse <{["Q", "43:73"]}>.) whatsoever they may desire
translations.43: (Unto them will be said)'. "Eat ye and drink ye in health and delight, as meed for what ye used to do"
translations.44: Verily, thus We recompense the doers of good
translations.45: Woe on the Day unto the beliers
translations.46: Eat ye and enjoy yourselves a little, for verily ye are the guilty ones
translations.47: Woe on the Day unto the beliers!
translations.48: And when it is said unto them "Bow ye down!" they bow not down
translations.49: Woe on that Day unto the beliers!
translations.50: In what other word after this will they believe?

exegesis.1:
'The Sent Forth', i.e., the winds which blow to the profit of everyone in the world.

The letter '_Waw'_ stands to mean swearing.

The benefits which the winds give in their flow are so many that they cannot be enumerated here. Everyone knows that they are the powerful factors which serve in innumerable ways. Air is the cause of life on earth. It is the winds that scatter the clouds and distribute the rainfall. It is the wind that gives life to the vegetable world by its cooling effect<{["F", 1]}>. It scatters seeds, it separates the chaff from grains. It cleanses the air of the poisonous and contagious matter in it. It carries the sound from one place to the other. It helps boats and ships to sail in the rivers and the high seas. It has innumerable other profits and benefits for mankind as well as the other units of God's creation but at the same time, the same winds if they become violent, become the cause of destruction and devastation. The winds can be the blessings of God as well as be the agents of His wrath and chastisement.

'_Mursalat'_ includes all the communicating agencies who convey the divine blessings and grace in various forms to the creatures in the various stages and realms, including angels, prophets and the other conscious and unconscious agencies functioning in communication. (A.P.)
exegesis.2:
The '_Fa'_ indicates that exciting as a result of the communicative function. (A.P.)

Exciting - excitement. (A.P.)
exegesis.9:
As the consequence of the radiation, causing gaps in the space. (A.P.)

As a consequence of the cessation of the radiation. (A.P.)
exegesis.11: When the apostles of God will be summoned to bear witness to the response, they met from their respective people with regard to the message they conveyed to them and the admonition they sounded<{["F", 1]}>.
exegesis.30:
It is said that the smoke from hell will be rising in three columns or branches.

The three columns correspond to the Psychical energy - attraction, repulsion, and devilish scheming. (A.P.)
exegesis.35: None shall be able to plead or to put forward any excuse for the facts will be laid so bare and the parts of their own body will themselves bear witness against them<{["F", 1]}>.
exegesis.36: Refers to a particular stage of the Day of Requital. (A.P.)
exegesis.46: The address is to the people lost in the enjoyment of this world for what they will be doing, will be only a trial for themselves.
exegesis.50: When such a clear message, the people reject, which is the other message they would accept to believe in? (A.P.)
